abilities.name: Berserker Frenzy

abilities.name: Executioner's Strike
abilities.description: A heavy attack that deals major physical damage and knocks back the target if it isn't blocked.

summary: Akash gra-Mal is an Orc warrior of the Darkfern Clan found in Elden Hollow I. She can be found in the second room after the waterfall, in front of a blacksmith's forge and a flaming altar of bone. She is clad in Wood Elf Style heavy armor. She and Canonreeve Oraneth are in an intimate relationship, as is evident from a letter from the canonreeve and Akash's dialogue.
